accueil.sousTitre: Moderation, levels, economy, tickets, giveaways, stream alerts… it purrs, you rule. Everything is set up in a few clicks from the dashboard.

pilotage.intro: The bot runs on your own machine, yet you never open a terminal: metrics, logs, backups and updates all live in the dashboard.

metriques.texte: The bot's memory and CPU, Discord latency, commands run, errors — with history kept in the database, so it survives restarts.

sauvegardes.texte: The bot backs the server up on its own, at the pace you set, keeps the latest ones and drops a copy in the channel of your choice.

restauration.texte: A backup carries the module configuration, the server structure and the member data. Download it, send it back, and missing channels and roles are recreated.

maj.texte: One button runs the bot's update (git pull and rebuild) on the branch you pick; restarts can be scheduled.

cta.texte: {nom} is open source and self-hosted: clone the repository, run your own instance, then configure everything from the web dashboard.
